1. An empty `podSelector` `{}` means the policy applies to ALL pods in the namespace
2. If `ingress` rules field is empty or absent, and only `policyTypes: [Ingress]`, then the policy denies ALL ingress traffic (default deny)

- `policyTypes: [Ingress]`

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-ingress
  namespace: policy
spec:
  podSelector: {}  # applies to all pods (server, allowed-client, blocked-client)
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: allowed  # Allow traffic FROM pods with role=allowed
```

- Traffic from `blocked-client` (which has label `role: blocked`) will still be DENIED
